data.description: The Parallel Bar is a single station in Ocean Grey: one post with a pair of angled bars that a user grips on either side of the body. The main exercise is the dip, where the user lowers and raises the body to work the arms, chest and shoulders. Less experienced users can keep their feet on the ground and use the bars for support during squats or stretches. It has no moving parts, which keeps upkeep low. The Parallel Bar fits a small corner of a society gym or a school ground. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the cover; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes. Ask us for a layout drawing.

items.pText: The Parallel Bar is a single station in Ocean Grey: one post with a pair of angled bars that a user grips on either side of the body. The main exercise is the dip, where the user lowers and raises the body to work the arms, chest and shoulders. Less experienced users can keep their feet on the ground and use the bars for support during squats or stretches. It has no moving parts, which keeps upkeep low. The Parallel Bar fits a small corner of a society gym or a school ground. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the cover; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes. Ask us for a layout drawing.

A single Parallel Bar is compact, but dips load it heavily, so we grout it unless the base is a solid slab. Lay an impact-absorbing surface under the bars. Inspect the welds and fixings at each service, and touch up the coating wherever it has chipped.
